instructions.description: Kneel on the floor and place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, directly under or slightly in front of your shoulders. Keep your knees on the floor and form a straight line from your head to your knees.
Cross your ankles if comfortable. Engage your core and lightly squeeze your glutes to maintain a stable body position. Keep your head and neck neutral.
Bend your elbows at approximately a 45-degree angle to your body and slowly lower your chest toward the floor. Keep your body in a straight line and avoid letting your hips sag or lift.

Push evenly through your palms to return to the starting position, extending your arms almost fully. Keep your core engaged and repeat the movement in a controlled manner through a full range of motion.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
